name: Hanoi Marvellous Hotel & Spa
vi: Khách sạn Hanoi Marvellous, 55 Đường Thành, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 55 Đường Thành, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000
tip: On Đường Thành itself, the same street as Chả Cá Thăng Long (6B) and 3 min from Nguyễn Quang Bích, so the whole 22 Sep evening is walkable and no Grab is needed. The HK Buslines coach drops in the Old Quarter, not at the door — expect a short Grab or 5-10 min walk with luggage. Coordinates estimated between no. 59 (Rose Hotel) and no. 39 on the same block.

name: Chả Cá Thăng Long
vi: Chả Cá Thăng Long, 6B (và 2D) Đường Thành, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 6B Đường Thành, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội (second door at 2D — NOT 19)
price: Set ~176,000 VND/person; ~400-500k VND for two with drinks
tip: MICHELIN Bib Gourmand 2025. The itinerary's '19 Đường Thành' is wrong — it is 6B/2D, and the block has copycat chả cá shops, so check the house number. ~250 m / 3 min walk from the hotel. Staff cook at the table; ask for mắm tôm on the side if you are unsure of it.

name: Chả Cá Lã Vọng
vi: Chả Cá Lã Vọng, 14 phố Chả Cá, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 14 Chả Cá, Hàng Bồ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: The century-old original that the street is named after, but reviews are mixed (3.6-4.3 on Tripadvisor) and it is roughly double Thăng Long's price for a smaller portion. Upstairs room is cramped and hot. ~600 m / 8 min walk from the hotel. A 21:00 close means a 19:30 booking is the practical latest.

name: Tranquil Books & Coffee
vi: Tranquil. Books & Coffee, 5 Nguyễn Quang Bích, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 5 Nguyễn Quang Bích, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: Open to 22:30, so the 21:00-22:30 slot fits, but it is a quiet reading cafe with live piano, not a late bar. Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves are the photo. ~250 m / 3 min from the hotel and ~150 m from Chả Cá Thăng Long. Tuesday is a normal weekday opening.

name: The Alchemist Cocktail Bar
vi: The Alchemist - Cocktail Bar, tầng 2, 19 Nguyễn Quang Bích, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 2nd floor, 19 Nguyễn Quang Bích, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: Second floor above a street-level shopfront with no large sign — look for the stairway, not a facade. Small room; message the Facebook page to hold a table for 21:00. ~300 m / 4 min from the hotel and 100 m from Tranquil, so the two are interchangeable on the night. Coordinates are the street number, not the upstairs unit.

name: Amanda Luxury Cruise (2D1N)
vi: Du thuyền Amanda Luxury, cảng Tuần Châu số 12, Hạ Long
addr: Boards at No. 12, Tuần Châu Marina, Tuan Chau Island, Hạ Long, Quảng Ninh
hours: Hanoi Old Quarter pick-up 07:45-08:30; marina arrival/check-in 11:30-12:00; board ~12:00; Day 2 disembark ~11:00
tip: Operator's published pick-up window is 07:45-08:30, not 07:30 — Amanda calls the hotel the evening before with a firm time, so confirm at check-in on 22 Sep. Boarding is via tender from the marina, so soft bags are easier down the gangway. Included: return Hanoi transfer, cabin, Day 1 lunch + dinner, Day 2 breakfast + brunch, activities, entrance fees, Wi-Fi, English-speaking cruise director. Excluded: all drinks, spa, private-car upgrade.

name: Tuần Châu International Marina
vi: Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Tuần Châu, đảo Tuần Châu, Hạ Long, Quảng Ninh
addr: Tuan Chau Island, Hạ Long, Quảng Ninh (Amanda uses gate/berth No. 12)
hours: Daily; Amanda check-in 11:30-12:00, Day 2 arrival back ~11:00
tip: Confirmed as the port Amanda uses for 2026 — not the newer Hạ Long International Cruise Port at Bãi Cháy, which is 8 km away on the mainland. The terminal seats 1,000, so go to gate 12 rather than the general hall. Day 2 the tender lands ~11:00, half an hour earlier than the itinerary assumes, which is spare time in your favour.

name: Trạm dừng nghỉ V52 Hải Dương (expressway rest stop)
vi: Trạm dừng nghỉ V52 Hải Dương, Km52+500 cao tốc Hà Nội - Hải Phòng, Bình Giang, Hải Dương
addr: Km52+500 Hanoi-Hải Phòng Expressway (CT.04), Bình Giang, Hải Dương
hours: 24h; buses stop ~10-20 min, typically 09:15-09:45 on a 07:45 Hanoi departure
tip: This is the halfway stop Hạ Long shuttles use (the other, V23/Km24+700 Hưng Yên, is too early in the run). It sells the Hải Dương specialities: bánh đậu xanh (Rồng Vàng Minh Ngọc, Hòa An, Nguyên Hương), bánh gai Ninh Giang and ổi Thanh Hà, plus fast food, coffee, clean toilets and a convenience store. Bánh giò is a Hanoi street snack and is not reliably sold here — buy that in the Old Quarter instead.

name: Maison Marou Hanoi (flagship)
vi: Maison Marou Hà Nội, 91A Thợ Nhuộm, Cửa Nam, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 91A Thợ Nhuộm, Cửa Nam, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: House number is 91A, not 91. The glass-walled chocolate workshop is the photo and the upstairs room is calmer than the ground-floor shop. It is the last easy souvenir stop before the airport and they gift-wrap, so buy bars here. ~1.2 km / 6 min Grab from the Hoàn Kiếm Legend luggage drop.

name: Blackbird Coffee (Chân Cầm)
vi: Cà Phê Blackbird, 5 Chân Cầm, Hàng Trống, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 5 Chân Cầm, Hàng Trống, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội (second branch 63B Lãn Ông)
tip: Not next to Maison Marou — it is ~1.0 km north near St Joseph's Cathedral, a 12 min walk or 5 min Grab, so treat it as an alternative to Marou, not an add-on in the same hour. Balcony seats over the street are the photo; the Lãn Ông branch looks over the herbal-medicine shops.

name: Bánh Mì Phố Huế
vi: Bánh Mỳ Phố Huế, 118 Phố Huế, Bùi Thị Xuân, Hai Bà Trưng
addr: 118 Phố Huế, Bùi Thị Xuân, Hai Bà Trưng, Hà Nội
hours: Roughly 06:00-21:00 daily; no official posting, busiest at breakfast and 17:00-19:00
tip: Family shop since 1974, known for a thick crisp baguette, pâté and house chilli sauce. It is 1.5 km south-east of Maison Marou, not walking distance from Thợ Nhuộm — a 6-8 min Grab, and the wrong direction for Nội Bài. Takeaway in practice; bank transfer accepted as well as cash.

name: Nội Bài International Airport - Terminal 1 (domestic)
vi: Nhà ga T1 (quốc nội), Sân bay quốc tế Nội Bài, Sóc Sơn, Hà Nội
addr: Domestic Terminal T1, Võ Nguyên Giáp, Phú Minh, Sóc Sơn, Hà Nội
price: Grab from the Old Quarter ~280,000-400,000 VND, 40-50 min via Nhật Tân bridge
tip: Departures are on the 2nd floor. Tell the Grab driver 'ga đi T1, tầng 2' or you get dropped at ground-level arrivals and carry bags up a level. T1 and T2 are ~600 m apart, so make sure the driver does not head for T2.

name: Cafe Phố Cổ
vi: Cà phê Phố Cổ, 11 Hàng Gai, Hàng Trống, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 11 Hàng Gai, Hàng Trống, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: Entrance is through a red silk shop signed 'Silklike' — walk the corridor, cross the courtyard, then up the stairs past a family shrine to the roof. No lift and the last flight is narrow, but it is short, not strenuous.
why: The Xiaohongshu/Instagram shot of the trip: rooftop egg coffee looking straight over Hoàn Kiếm Lake and Turtle Tower, ~430 m / 6 min walk from the hotel and open late enough for the 21:00-22:30 slot.

name: Bánh Mì 25
vi: Bánh Mì 25, 25 Hàng Cá, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 25 Hàng Cá, Hàng Bồ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: Queue is normal; order at the street counter and take a table in the sit-down room opposite. Staff speak good English and card/QR pay works.
why: Hanoi's most photographed bánh mì and a far more convenient version of the 'Bánh Mì Phố Huế' idea — 570 m / 8 min walk from the hotel and 100 m from Chả Cá Lã Vọng, so it doubles as a light supper or a morning grab before the 23 Sep pick-up.
near: Hanoi Marvellous Hotel / Chả Cá Lã Vọng

name: Chè 4 Mùa
vi: Chè 4 Mùa, 4 Hàng Cân, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 4 Hàng Cân, Hàng Bồ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: Tiny shopfront with plastic stools; point at the display if the menu defeats you. Chè thập cẩm and chè bưởi are the ones to order.
why: Old Quarter chè institution running since 1975 and the obvious dessert stop if you pick Chả Cá Lã Vọng — it is 100 m from the restaurant door and 485 m / 7 min from the hotel.
near: Chả Cá Lã Vọng (22 Sep evening)

name: Bún Chả Đắc Kim
vi: Bún Chả Đắc Kim, 1 Hàng Mành, Hàng Gai, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 1 Hàng Mành, Hàng Gai, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: Portions are large — one bún chả plus one plate of nem for two is enough. Upstairs is air-conditioned. Coordinates are the Hàng Mành street head, not the exact doorway.
why: The nearest well-known non-chả-cá dinner to the hotel, ~150 m / 2 min walk, and the fallback if Chả Cá Thăng Long has no table at 19:30 on arrival night.

name: ACID8 Coffee Roasters
vi: ACID8, 34 Xóm Hạ Hồi, Trần Hưng Đạo, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 34 Xóm Hạ Hồi, Trần Hưng Đạo, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: Down the quiet Hạ Hồi alley off Trần Hưng Đạo, two-storey and almost entirely red inside. Its sister bar VULAB (30B, white-grey) is a few doors along, so you get two looks in one alley. Photon could not resolve the alley — pin it in Grab by name before you set off.
why: The strongest specialty-coffee cluster within walking distance of Thợ Nhuộm (~700 m from Maison Marou), and the red interior is the Xiaohongshu-friendly one if Marou is packed on the 24th.
near: Maison Marou / Thợ Nhuộm (24 Sep afternoon)

name: Kem Tràng Tiền
vi: Kem Tràng Tiền, 35 Tràng Tiền, Hoàn Kiếm
addr: 35 Tràng Tiền, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội
tip: You eat standing in the courtyard, Hanoi-style — that queue-and-crowd shot is the point. Taro, coconut and green bean are the classics; 2025 added take-home boxes and coffee-crunch and salted-caramel-coconut flavours.
why: A 600 m / 8 min walk east of Maison Marou past the Opera House, so it slots into the 14:15-15:30 window without a Grab and gives a second, very different photo stop.

name: Oriberry Coffee (Xuân Diệu)
vi: Oriberry Coffee, 25 Xuân Diệu, Tây Hồ
addr: 25 Xuân Diệu, Tây Hồ, Hà Nội (listed as 21 Xuân Diệu on some sites)
tip: Three floors, plenty of tables and power points, and it stays open to 23:00. Xuân Diệu traffic is heavy 17:00-19:00, so leave for the airport before 16:30 if you stop here.
why: The one genuine ~10 min detour on the 15:45 Grab run: Xuân Diệu sits right on the Yên Phụ-Âu Cơ approach to Nhật Tân bridge, and it gives a West Lake view without doubling back into the Old Quarter.
near: Nhật Tân bridge / route to Nội Bài T1
